\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item to change, to move, to take off, to leave, to lose

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To order? (\textbf{ordinare}.) To cut? (\textbf{tagliare}.) To dry? (\textbf{asciugare}.) To iron? (\textbf{stirare}.) To build? (\textbf{costruire}.) To change? (\textbf{cambiare}.) To move? (\textbf{spostare}.) To take off? (\textbf{togliere}.) To leave? (\textbf{lasciare}.) To lose? (\textbf{perdere}.) To check? (\textbf{controllare}.) To sign? (\textbf{firmare}.) To fill in? (\textbf{compilare}.) To send? (\textbf{spedire}.) To receive? (\textbf{ricevere}.) To rest? (\textbf{riposare}.) To wake up? (\textbf{svegliarsi}.) To comb one's hair? (\textbf{pettinarsi}.) To be bored? (\textbf{annoiarsi}.) To have fun? (\textbf{divertirsi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

  \item to point out, to inform, to dispatch, to complain, to be missing
  \item to reach, to achieve, to give, to give back, to recognise
  \item to push, to pull, to waste, to overtake, to perform
  \item to deliver, to correct, to direct, to destroy, to exaggerate

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To warn? (\textbf{avvisare}.) To burn? (\textbf{bruciare}.) To throw away? (\textbf{buttare}.) To calculate? (\textbf{calcolare}.) To hit? (\textbf{colpire}.) To point out? (\textbf{indicare}.) To inform? (\textbf{informare}.) To dispatch? (\textbf{inviare}.) To complain? (\textbf{lamentarsi}.) To be missing? (\textbf{mancare}.) To reach? (\textbf{raggiungere}.) To achieve? (\textbf{realizzare}.) To give? (\textbf{regalare}.) To give back? (\textbf{restituire}.) To recognise? (\textbf{riconoscere}.) To push? (\textbf{spingere}.) To pull? (\textbf{tirare}.) To waste? (\textbf{sprecare}.) To overtake? (\textbf{superare}.) To perform? (\textbf{svolgere}.) To deliver? (\textbf{consegnare}.) To correct? (\textbf{correggere}.) To direct? (\textbf{dirigere}.) To destroy? (\textbf{distruggere}.) To exaggerate? (\textbf{esagerare}.)
